description: Football match at Atanasio Girardot stadium; Carrera 70 closed 16:00-22:00, detour via Calle 44 and Carrera 76.
decision_reason: There are HIGH alerts, but they can be mitigated; the mitigations become conditions.

alerts.because: Flow rises more than 30% on a street whose bike lane has no physical separation.
A massive event at the stadium coincides with active works on a parallel corridor.
More than 20,000 people leave the event and the Metro station entrance is on the closed street.

recommendations: Place traffic agents at the detour hotspot
Add temporary separators on the bike lane
Suspend works on the parallel corridor during the event
Request extra Metro staff at the station entrance

questions_asked.question: Is a Metro station entrance on the closed street?
